decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf draws directly on the firm's core baking tradition and craft knowledge, so it fits existing know-how and is easy to sustain within the everyday range.
The sweet pastry builds on established confectionery skills and recipes, so the firm can judge and adjust it from routine sales feedback, though such items rotate more often.
The crusty farmhouse bread is a close extension of the heritage bread assortment, needs no new knowledge and complements the core business.
The poppy seed stollen is a flagship with an external gold award, which confirms the firm's deep stollen expertise and gives it clear evidence to build on.
The premium stollen also won gold and rests on the firm's traditional seasonal craft, making it a validated, high-value product that fits existing competencies.
